_readme: Hand corrections to Whisper's transcripts, applied after transcription and
before anything is rendered. Keyed by slug, then by segment index.
`was` must match the transcript exactly or the fix is skipped with a warning.
That is deliberate: if a re-transcription produces different text, a blind
replacement would put the wrong words on screen at the wrong timing. A skipped
fix is a prompt to look, not a failure.
Only put a correction here when the transcript is not English as written, or
when it mangles a proper noun. Anything that merely reads oddly but could be
what is actually rapped belongs in Jordan's ear, not in this file.
Where Jordan has supplied the real lyric sheet, that is the source of truth and beats any reading of the audio. Ask him for the sheet before guessing.

dk.why: 'done in Kruger' is Dunning-Kruger, the whole subject of the track

infinite-possbilities.why: 'but as free will and illusion of our own reflection' is not a sentence

infinite-possbilities.now: thread redeems, the world's in flux
infinite-possbilities.why: 'influx' is 'in flux' — the line is about a world that will not hold still

burnout-society.why: Whisper's stray space before a hyphen, visible on screen

between-the-body-and-the-fabric.now: in form, NPCs in a loop
between-the-body-and-the-fabric.why: 'shadows inform NPCs' is not what is sung; it is 'shadows in form'

between-the-body-and-the-fabric.now: It's a maze in the dark
between-the-body-and-the-fabric.why: the line ends 'with no map in sight', which only parses with a maze

natsukashii.now: picture got a ghost around them

pleasure-vs-purpose.why: from Jordan's lyric sheet; the chorus opens 'Hedonist highs or a life of meaning'

love-of-honor.why: the track is called Love of Honor, which is the English gloss of the Greek philotimo. Whisper heard the word as 'lot of mo', the same way it heard 'fugazi' as 'full gazey'

ananda.why: Advaita Vedanta verse: naham tarangah, sagaro aham, 'I am not the wave, I am the ocean'. Whisper split it mid-word and lost it

mind-of-the-year.why: Socrates calls himself the gadfly of Athens in the Apology
the Delphic oracle said no one was wiser than Socrates
the Apology examines politicians, poets and craftsmen in that order, which is exactly the sequence of these three lines

sisyphus-smiles.why: Sisyphus pushes a boulder, not a bolder
'Absurd he' is the -ity ending misheard; the next line is 'but you choose how to feel', so the subject is the absurd, not a person

prison-of-the-will.why: Whisper split the philosopher's name across two segments and heard the first half as a word. The line before is 'one man saw the whole insane', and the track is about the denial of the will, so it is him.
the 'how' is the tail of Schopenhauer, moved into segment 10.

rise-and-fall.why: 'Commarses' is not a word. The line sits between 'from warriors to merchants' and 'trade routes expand', so it is Commerce.

dia-de-los-muertos.why: 'lie to candles' is not a phrase. It sits between 'that's the expectation' and 'say your prayer, set the spirits free', so it is lighting candles.

bullshit-jobs.why: The track is David Graeber's Bullshit Jobs and the last line names him; Whisper heard the surname as 'graver'. Only the name is corrected: the rest of the line is still doubtful and needs Jordan's ear. It falls inside the end-card window at 28.7s, so it is never shown on screen either way.

uncarved-block.why: Whisper heard Tao as the stock index. The track is the Daodejing's uncarved block and the next line is 'flow like the water', so it is the Tao.

group-think-chronicles.why: The track is called Group Think Chronicles; Whisper heard the compound as two words.

group-think-chronicles.now: on fear never sets you free
group-think-chronicles.why: 'nevertheless you're free' does not parse after 'peace built on fear'; the rapped line is 'never sets you free'.

escape-the-code.why: The track is The Matrix; the protagonist is Neo.
There is no Kane in The Matrix. The previous segment ends on Morpheus, so the line is 'Morpheus came, said here's the key'.

cash-rules-nothing-around-me.why: 'By the dream sell the soul' is 'Buy the dream, sell the soul'.
second half of the same line.

cult-of-one.why: 'frag the code' is not the line; it is 'crack the code'.
